meta.instruction:
TASK (do ONLY this): determine the CAUSE of an inner-being state, per item.
For each item: read `verse_text`; in a SHORT phrase (<=8 words) state what AROUSES the inner state named by `term` in THIS verse. `cause_clause` is a mechanical hint (the clause after a 'because/for' marker) — it may or may not be the real cause; judge from the verse. If the verse does NOT actually state what causes the state, return "NONE". Do not infer beyond the text; do not add commentary.
OUTPUT: a JSON array only — [{"vcid": <int>, "cause": "<phrase or NONE>"}] — one object per input item.
